method: Read explicit integer seed fields (including nested seed lists/maps) from the bound historical configurations, protocols and data manifests; compare every new declared seed against their union. No old outcome metrics or model weights are inspected.
scope: Explicit archived seed declarations for pilots v1-v5, platform calibration/examples, task-count v1/v2 including engineering protocols, and relation_readout_v1. This is a recorded-seed novelty check, not a proof of disjoint pseudorandom sequences or probabilistic independence.
